author: BMF7
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_covenant_stmt_if_false_refutation.rs::stmt_position_if_value_must_be_discarded_not_a_false_refutation demonstrates the divergence. Root cause: forge/src/covenant_eval.rs eval_stmts Stmt::If arm reads the taken branch's then.tail/else_.tail and returns it as an early return of the enclosing block; the parser (thermite-syntax parser.rs TokKind::If arm) emits Stmt::If for a non-tail-position if/else even when its branches carry tail exprs. Rust/Verus executable semantics discard a statement-position if's value. Net effect: a correct item (alwayszero returning 0 via a discarded if/else, ens result==0) is falsely CovenantRefuted and blocked from the L3 burn, while the control body { 0 } burns to L3. Violates REQ-4 (falsify aimed at executable semantics) and the covenant_eval 'never a silent wrong value' contract.
